abstract: We develop new datasets of monthly grain prices in 14 urban markets and of the storage and marketing of grain by 5 rural estates located in western Germany between the late seventeenth century and c . 1860. We explore whether observed patterns of monthly prices, sales, and storage of grain are consistent with the rational competitive storage model (RCSM). Results establish, first, that the crop year was divided into two seasons characterized by processing and marketing, respectively. Monthly prices of wheat during the marketing season (from February to summer) showed a pattern consistent with the rational competitive storage model. In the case of rye, which was a subsistence crop, a pattern of monthly prices consistent with the RCSM emerged only in the nineteenth century and was confined to urban markets. Second, grain price movements in spring and early summer predicted November prices, which implies the presence of inter‐annual arbitrage. Whereas carry‐over stocks held by rural estates partly served to provision a large household, tentative evidence suggests that some rural estates indeed also engaged in inter‐annual arbitrage, but they do not seem to have been able to earn a profit from holding carryover stocks.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了涵盖17世纪末至约1860年间德国西部14个城市市场的月度谷物价格数据集，以及5个乡村庄园的谷物储存与销售数据集。我们探究观察到的月度价格、销售及储存模式是否与理性竞争性储存模型（RCSM）相符。研究结果首先表明，农作物年度被划分为两个季节，分别以加工和销售为特征。小麦在销售季节（从二月至夏季）的月度价格模式与理性竞争性储存模型一致。对于作为生存作物的黑麦，其月度价格模式仅在19世纪才显现出与RCSM相符的特征，且仅限于城市市场。其次，春季及初夏的谷物价格变动能够预测十一月的价格，这暗示着存在跨年度套利行为。尽管乡村庄园持有的结转库存部分用于供应大型家庭所需，初步证据表明，一些乡村庄园确实也参与了跨年度套利，但他们似乎未能从持有结转库存中获利。
title: The slow emergence of the rational investor: Grain markets and grain storage of rural estates in western Germany, eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries
title_zh: 理性投资者的缓慢崛起：18至19世纪初德国西部农村庄园的谷物市场与谷物储存

abstract: We study a seat allocation problem in public transportation with potential seating restrictions. We first demonstrate that the commonly used procedure suffers from significant drawbacks, including welfare losses due to unfilled seats. We then introduce a new mechanism that addresses these deficiencies while also satisfying several other desirable properties under various seating restrictions. We also show that our proposed mechanism ensures that the maximum number of agents are seated while respecting agents' preferences and priority rankings.
abstract_zh: 我们研究公共交通中可能存在的座位限制下的座位分配问题。首先，我们证明常用程序存在显著缺陷，包括因空座导致的福利损失。随后，我们引入一种新机制，该机制在解决这些缺陷的同时，还满足多种座位限制下的其他理想性质。我们还表明，我们提出的机制确保在尊重乘客偏好和优先级排序的前提下，尽可能多的乘客能够就座。
title: Seat allocation problem in public transportation
title_zh: 公共交通中的座位分配问题

abstract: We examine the relationship between shareholder leverage constraints and corporate risk-taking, focusing on its impact on debtholders. Our findings show that mutual fund leverage constraints are related to more risk-taking activities of portfolio companies, inducing higher credit risk and greater risk-shifting concerns for the firms’ debtholders. In response, the debtholders raise borrowing costs and tighten lending conditions. These effects intensify for firms facing higher levels of conflict between debtholders and shareholders and when mutual funds exert greater influence over firms. Econometric analyses, including instrumental variable specifications and asset management company mergers, support a causal interpretation.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了股东杠杆约束与企业风险承担之间的关系，重点关注其对债权人的影响。研究结果显示，共同基金的杠杆约束与投资组合公司更多的风险承担活动相关，从而引发更高的信用风险，并加剧企业债权人的风险转移担忧。作为回应，债权人提高了借款成本并收紧了贷款条件。这些效应在企业面临更高水平的债权人与股东冲突时，以及共同基金对企业施加更大影响力时更为显著。计量经济学分析，包括工具变量设定和资产管理公司合并案例，支持因果解释。
journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
title: Do Shareholder Leverage Constraints Affect Debtholders?
title_zh: 股东杠杆约束是否影响债权人？

abstract: We consider strategy-proof social choice correspondences (SCCs) –mappings from preference profiles to sets of alternatives– when individuals are endowed with single-peaked preferences over alternatives. We interpret the selected sets of alternatives as the basis for lotteries that determine the final social choice, and consider that agents’ preferences over sets are consistent with Expected Utility Theory and Bayesian updating from an initial probability assessment over the full set of alternatives. We exploit the relation between SCCs and probabilistic decision schemes –mappings from preference profiles to lotteries over alternatives–, to characterize the family of SCCs that satisfy strategy-proofness and unanimity for arbitrary initial probability assessments. We extend the analysis to multi-dimensional convex spaces of alternatives under the uniform initial probability assessment.
abstract_zh: 本文考虑策略性防策略的社会选择对应（SCCs）——即从偏好分布到备选方案集合的映射——当个体对备选方案具有单峰偏好时。我们将所选的备选方案集合视为决定最终社会选择的抽签基础，并假设个体对集合的偏好与期望效用理论一致，且基于对全部备选方案的初始概率评估进行贝叶斯更新。通过利用SCCs与概率决策方案（即从偏好分布到备选方案抽签的映射）之间的关系，我们刻画了在任意初始概率评估下满足策略防策略性和一致性的SCCs族。在均匀初始概率评估假设下，我们将分析扩展至多维凸空间中的备选方案。
title: Strategy-Proof social choice correspondences and single-peaked preferences
title_zh: 防策略性社会选择对应与单峰偏好

abstract: The paper discusses the novel but little‐known exchange rate system of Japanese‐occupied North China during the Second Sino‐Japanese War, in which exporters were given the right to import in the form of a piece of yellow paper, which could be sold in the secondary market. In an environment of rapid inflation where North China's currency was pegged to the Japanese yen and devaluation was not politically feasible, the system incentivized exports by allowing the exporters to offset their losses with the profits from selling goods imported, or the right to import goods, at the overvalued exchange rate. Following the start of the Pacific War, the system evolved to become a major scheme of facilitating trade between North and Central China under Japanese occupation. The paper, utilizing the classified documents of the Yokohama Specie Bank, reconstructs analytically how the system operated. Further, our analysis, based on monthly average data, confirms that the secondary market pricing of yellow paper broadly mimicked the operation of a flexible exchange rate. The system died a natural death when exploding inflation in Central China eliminated the export disincentive in North China.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了第二次中日战争期间日本占领下的华北地区一种新颖但鲜为人知的外汇制度，在该制度下，出口商被赋予进口权，形式为一张黄纸，可在二级市场出售。在华北货币盯住日元且贬值在政治上不可行的快速通胀环境下，该制度通过允许出口商以高估汇率出售进口商品或进口权来弥补损失，从而激励出口。太平洋战争爆发后，该制度演变为日本占领下华北与华中之间促进贸易的主要机制。本文利用横滨正金银行的机密文件，分析性地重建了该制度的运作方式。此外，基于月度平均数据的分析证实，黄纸的二级市场定价大致模拟了浮动汇率的运作。当华中地区恶性通胀消除了华北出口抑制因素时，该制度自然消亡。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Building a Potemkin village in occupied China: Japan's wartime system of linked trade, 1939–43
title_zh: 在占领区中国建造波将金村：日本的战时关联贸易体系（1939–1943）
